market-customer-analysis 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Market & Customer Insight skill, supporting interactive HTML one-page reports for market and customer analysis.
- Implements a standardized workflow based on ST analysis (Segmentation/Targeting/Scenario), APPEALS 7-dimension needs model, and KANO model.
- Strict data discipline: all external data must include source, URL, date, and confidence level; no conjectured numbers.
- Clear boundaries: focuses only on customer/market needs; does not produce positioning statements or 4P analysis.
- Delivers structured outputs including segmentation tables, persona cards, radar charts, KANO matrices, blue ocean opportunity scoring, and prioritized strategic recommendations.
- Input collection includes robust multi-step prompting and explicit user authorization for web data fetching if needed.
